pierre.subject: A single irregular gray stone
pierre.details: Rounded asymmetrical rock silhouette, composed of large and medium polygonal facets with subtle fine mineral surface detail.
pierre.palette: Cool slate-gray and pale gray surfaces, darker charcoal-gray lower faces.
pierre.ownerPrompt: A single irregular gray stone, premium stylized 3D low-poly game resource icon. Rounded asymmetrical rock silhouette, composed of large and medium polygonal facets with subtle fine mineral surface detail. Cool slate-gray and pale gray surfaces, softly illuminated by a warm golden-white key light from the upper left. Delicate highlights along a few facet edges, darker charcoal-gray lower faces, soft ambient occlusion between facets. Slight three-quarter view, centered, visually substantial and readable at small sizes. Modern polished fantasy mining game aesthetic, sophisticated but not photorealistic, neither cartoon emoji nor flat vector art. One isolated rock only. No text, no border, no UI card, no pedestal, no scenery, no floor, no cast shadow outside the object. True transparent alpha background. Square 1024x1024 canvas, object occupying approximately 75 percent of canvas, consistent margins.
pierre.note: Première génération sans référence (consigne du propriétaire du 29/10/2026) : le prompt envoyé est ownerPrompt, mot pour mot.

charbon.subject: A single irregular lump of raw coal
charbon.details: Rounded asymmetrical chunk with the same silhouette scale as the reference stone, composed of large and medium sharp polygonal facets; a few facets have a subtle glassy sheen typical of anthracite, with fine mineral surface detail.
charbon.palette: Deep charcoal-black and very dark graphite surfaces with faint cool blue-gray reflections on the lit facets, near-black lower faces; it must stay clearly readable against a dark brown-black background.

minerai_fer.subject: A single irregular chunk of iron ore
minerai_fer.details: The same faceted gray rock as the reference stone, with several embedded metallic iron nodules and veins breaking through the facets, plus small patches of rusty oxidation around them.
minerai_fer.palette: Cool slate-gray rock surfaces, steel-gray metallic inclusions with bright silver highlights, warm rust-orange and reddish-brown oxide patches, darker charcoal-gray lower faces.

diamant.subject: A single raw diamond crystal
diamant.details: Rough uncut octahedral gemstone with the same silhouette scale as the reference stone, made of large and medium translucent polygonal facets with crisp internal refractions; not a jewelry cut, not set in rock.
diamant.palette: Icy pale cyan, white and light sky-blue translucent facets with bright sparkling highlights, deeper blue tones on the lower faces.
